segments.thag6.5:1.3: So plavatī [plavati (sī. pī. ka.), pariplavati (syā.)] hurā huraṃ, phalamicchaṃva vanasmi vānaro.
segments.thag6.5:2.1: “Yaṃ esā sahate [sahati (pī. ka.)] jammī, taṇhā loke visattikā;
segments.thag6.5:2.3: Sokā tassa pavaḍḍhanti, abhivaṭṭhaṃva [abhivuṭṭhaṃva (syā.), abhivaḍḍhaṃva (ka.)] bīraṇaṃ.
segments.thag6.5:3.1: “Yo cetaṃ sahate [sahati (pī. ka.)] jammiṃ, taṇhaṃ loke duraccayaṃ;
segments.thag6.5:4.1: “Taṃ vo vadāmi bhaddaṃ vo, yāvantettha samāgatā;
segments.thag6.5:4.5: Mā vo naḷaṃva sotova, māro bhañji punappunaṃ.
segments.thag6.5:6.1: “Pamādo rajo pamādo [sabbadā (sī. ka.), suttanipātaṭṭhakathāyaṃ uṭṭhānasuttavaṇṇanā oloketabbā], pamādānupatito rajo;
